title: X Feed Digest
summary: 🤖 **AI Model Wars:** Anthropic ships Opus 4.6 with 'sabotage risk' reports; OpenAI counters with Deep Research via GPT-5.2.
🏗️ **Infrastructure:** Cisco challenges Nvidia/Broadcom with G300 chips; Google bond demand signals massive market trust.
📉 **Macro Shifts:** Chinese households aggressively deleverage (loans collapse, savings soar); Databricks hits $134B valuation.
✨ **Culture:** 'Vibe coding' goes mainstream as non-engineers ship production apps with AI agents.

items.title: Anthropic (@AnthropicAI)
items.body: Released Claude Opus 4.6 with a dedicated 'sabotage risk' report, meeting Safety Level 4 standards for autonomous R&D.

items.title: OpenAI (@OpenAI)
items.body: ChatGPT Deep Research is now powered by GPT-5.2, featuring app connections and real-time progress tracking.

items.title: Alibaba Qwen (@Alibaba_Qwen)

items.title: Isomorphic Labs (@IsomorphicLabs)

items.title: Ariel Reyes (@ReyezAriel)

items.title: The Next Web (@thenextweb)
items.body: Databricks hits $5.4B revenue run rate and $134B valuation, driven by 65% YoY growth and heavy AI adoption.

items.body: China's household data shows massive deleveraging: 2025 new loans dropped to 0.44T RMB (vs 7.36T in 2018) while savings doubled.
